title: Rounding to Tens and Hundreds
introduction: Develop Primary 3 skills in rounding to tens and hundreds.
definition: To round to the nearest ten, inspect the ones digit. To round to the nearest hundred, inspect the tens digit. Digits 0–4 round down and 5–9 round up; replace lower places with zeros.

examples.question: Round 2,467 to the nearest hundred.
steps: The tens digit is 6, so round up.

examples.question: Round 3,984 to the nearest ten.
steps: The ones digit is 4, so round down.

exercises.question: Round 4,728 to nearest ten.
exercises.solution: 4,728 is 2 away from 4,730 and 8 away from 4,720; round to 4,730.

exercises.question: Round 6,345 to nearest hundred.
exercises.solution: 6,345 is 45 away from 6,300 and 55 away from 6,400; round to 6,300.

exercises.question: Round 7,650 to nearest hundred.
exercises.solution: 7,650 is halfway between 7,600 and 7,700; round up to 7,700.

exercises.question: Round 9,995 to nearest ten.
exercises.solution: 9,995 is halfway between 9,990 and 10,000; round up to 10,000.

exercises.question: Round 8,049 to nearest hundred.
exercises.solution: 8,049 is 49 away from 8,000 and 51 away from 8,100; round to 8,000.

exercises.question: Round 1,050 to nearest hundred.
exercises.solution: 1,050 is halfway between 1,000 and 1,100; round up to 1,100.

summary: To round to the nearest ten, inspect the ones digit. To round to the nearest hundred, inspect the tens digit. Digits 0–4 round down and 5–9 round up; replace lower places with zeros.
